data.gender_notes: Luke is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Luke is recorded in name-lists as “Light-giving; from Lucania”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Luke expresses “Light-giving; from Lucania”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luke total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek Loukas, associated with lux/light or with Lucania in southern Italy. Its root is Greek loukas. Luke the Evangelist; the Gospel of Luke. Luke is a Greek name meaning “Light-giving; from Lucania”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
